meta_description: Open a support ticket for an OpenDrone order, build or warranty question. The team answers on your ticket page.
title: Support
lede: Tell us what is going on. The team answers on your ticket page, and your private link brings you back to it from any device.
unavailable: Tickets are not available right now. Try again in a few minutes, or ask the community on Discord.
topic_warranty_hint: A defect, damage, sending an item back
email_hint: Used for this ticket only. Replies appear on your ticket page.
email_hint_notify: Used for this ticket only. We email you when the team replies.
message_placeholder_order: What do you need to know or change about your order?
message_placeholder_product: What you are building, what you expected and what happens instead.
message_placeholder_warranty: What happened, when, and how the board was powered. Photos or a short video help a lot.
files_hint: Up to 5 files, 8 MB each: photos, video, logs, blackbox, firmware.
file_total_too_big: The files add up to more than 24 MB.
file_type: {file}: this file type is not accepted.
privacy_note: Tickets are kept for 24 months after they close. [Privacy policy](/privacy).
err_invalid_email: Enter an email address like name@example.com.
err_too_short: A few more words help us help you.
err_too_long: That is over 4000 characters. Attach longer logs as a file.
err_filtered: This looks like it contains a password, token or card number. Remove it and send again.
err_turnstile: We could not confirm you are human. Try again.
err_rate: Too many requests from here. Try again in an hour.
err_email_limit: This email opened five tickets today. Add to one of them instead.
err_send: Your message could not be sent. Nothing was lost: try again in a moment.
err_forbidden: This request did not come from the support page. Reload and try again.
err_unavailable: Tickets are not available right now. Try again in a few minutes, or ask the community on Discord.
find_body: Find a ticket with your email and its order number or ticket number.
community_body: Build and tuning questions often get a fast answer from other pilots on Discord.
sales_body: Shops and distributors: send a [trade enquiry](/wholesale). Other business and press:
status_open_hint: The team answers here. You can close this page: your link brings you back.
status_answered_hint: The team replied. Answer below if you need more, or mark it solved.
status_waiting_hint: The team needs something from you to continue.
status_closed_hint: This ticket is closed. Writing a new message reopens it.
created_body: Save your private link below: it is the way back to this ticket.
link_body: Anyone with this link can read and answer this ticket. It works for 90 days; this page always shows a fresh one.
reset_confirm: The current link stops working on every device. Continue?
reset_done: New link ready. The old one no longer works.
notify_off: Replies are not emailed. This page updates while it is open.
notify_on: We email you when the team replies.
system_auto_closed: Closed after 30 days without a reply.
offline: Could not check for replies. Retrying.
gone_title: This ticket is not available here
gone_body: The link may be old or replaced, or this browser has not opened the ticket before. Find it with your email and its order or ticket number.
find_lede: Enter the email you used and the order number or ticket number. Ticket numbers look like OD-K7M4-Q2XF.
find_none: No ticket matches those details. Check the email and the number, or open a new ticket.
resume_invalid_body: Links last 90 days, and a replaced link stops working at once. Find your ticket with your email and its order or ticket number.
